mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading designates the entire area inside the equilateral triangle. Right image: The shaded region is the epigraph, the set of points with vertical coordinate at least f(x).
Rationales: The feature selects a geometric area in the left image and selects the epigraph of a function in the right image. The cyan triangle with three 3 cm side labels. The gray region above the curve labeled f and marked epi f.
